## Relationships

### [Faith](../character/faith.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/faith--minnie.md)

Minnie and [Faith](../character/faith.md) are best friends who know each other from school. During a period when the adults are away or incapacitated, [Faith](../character/faith.md) takes on the responsibilities of managing the house alongside [Una](../character/una-meredith.md). Her attempts at housework, such as shaking rugs in the graveyard, accidentally spark local rumors and scandal among churchgoers.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER X. THE MANSE GIRLS CLEAN HOUSE P10](../source/v05-c10.md#nw-v05-c10-p0010), [v5 CHAPTER X. THE MANSE GIRLS CLEAN HOUSE P35](../source/v05-c10.md#nw-v05-c10-p0035), [v5 CHAPTER X. THE MANSE GIRLS CLEAN HOUSE P38](../source/v05-c10.md#nw-v05-c10-p0038), +2 more_
